verdict.rationale: Convex documents an official CLI (`npx convex`) with dev-mode filesystem watching and push, `run` for executing functions, `logs`, `insights`, `import`, and `npm create convex@latest` scaffolding. These scriptable commands suit agent-driven workflows, and the docs say Convex works well with coding agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of agent-specific CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth.
